dialogue.arrival: I brought three competing quotes. One is even real.
dialogue.concern: Put the full price on one line.
dialogue.accept: That discount works. Keep the mystery fees.
dialogue.walk: I'll let your spreadsheet think about it.

dialogue.arrival: Will the valet remember this one?
dialogue.concern: Show me the cabin, not the keychain.
dialogue.accept: That's the one. Please remove the giant bow.

dialogue.arrival: I have a checklist. My dad has a longer checklist.
dialogue.concern: Can you explain that repair in normal words?
dialogue.accept: I understand the total. Let's do it.
dialogue.walk: I need time to read the report.

dialogue.arrival: Cold start first. Small talk second.
dialogue.concern: Those readings don't match the description.
dialogue.accept: The numbers check out. You kept the receipts.
dialogue.walk: I like the car more than your explanation.

dialogue.arrival: Three kids. One dog. Nothing sticky, please.
dialogue.concern: Show me the inspection and the back seat.
dialogue.walk: We'll keep looking. The dog has concerns.

dialogue.arrival: Can we move that cone? It's ruining my reveal.
dialogue.concern: Is that mark visible in daylight?
dialogue.accept: Deal. You may wave in the background.
dialogue.walk: The car needs a better angle. So does the price.

dialogue.arrival: Half price, cash today. I rehearsed that.
dialogue.accept: You held your line. I respect that.
dialogue.walk: I'll be back with the same offer and sunglasses.

dialogue.arrival: Something quick. My accountant is parked outside.
dialogue.concern: I still want the service history.
dialogue.accept: Wrap up the paperwork before my accountant comes in.
dialogue.walk: Expensive isn't the same as interesting.

dialogue.arrival: Forty miles each way. Make tomorrow boring.
dialogue.accept: Reliable and within budget. That's exciting enough.
dialogue.walk: I need transport, not a weekend project.

dialogue.arrival: The truck works before I do.
dialogue.concern: Show me the wear, then show me the bill.
dialogue.accept: Room for the tools. Room in the budget. Sold.
dialogue.walk: I can't send an invoice from the garage.

marco.line: Welcome to Chief Auto. The sign is big. Our cash reserve is not.
Your maximum bid includes the repair bill you haven't met yet.
A report costs money. A surprise costs more.
Ray is family. That is a relationship, not a warranty.
Put it back on the inspection list. Optimism is not a repair.
A fair deal. Terrible gossip, excellent business.
They kept their money. You kept your car. We can survive this.
Parking spaces are inventory limits with painted lines.
Today's hot class is on the board. Tomorrow it may just be yesterday's stock.
Winning the auction and making money are separate hobbies.
Tell them before the signature. Surprises belong at birthdays.
That zero was ambitious. Fix it.
Count what you paid, what you repaired, and what you actually received.
More sourcing options. Still the same bank account.
Leave enough for repairs and bills. The desk can stay ugly another week.
Read the complaint twice. Write the reply once.
Delegate the sale. Keep responsibility for the promise.
Rent does not care how impressive the showroom looks.
No sale today. Let's find out whether it was the car, the price, or the pitch.
You qualify for the building. Check that you can also afford the morning after.
One month down. Count the cash, the stock, and the obligations. Then celebrate.
Borrowed cash is not profit. Put that on the whiteboard.
The job is finished. Verify the result before pricing the car.
We recovered cash. We did not invent a profit.

dialogue.opening: I know a buyer for that.
dialogue.stop: My buyer suddenly got less enthusiastic.

dialogue.opening: Could fit a board in that.

dialogue.outbid: There's still room in the collection.
